🔴AI industry mein is samay investors sabse zyada ek baat dekh rahe hain company kitna revenue kama rahi hai, kitna profit bana rahi hai, AI infrastructure par kitna paisa kharch kar rahi hai aur us investment ka return kab milega. Isi uncertainty ki wajah se AI-related companies ke shares par pressure aata hai aur market mein selling dekhne ko mil sakti hai.
🔴Agar Chinese AI companies kam cost mein achhe models provide karti hain, to global AI market mein price war shuru ho sakti hai. Price war ka matlab hai ki OpenAI, Google, Anthropic aur doosri companies ko bhi apni services ki pricing kam karni pad sakti hai. Jab selling price kam hoti hai aur infrastructure ka kharcha utna hi rehta hai, to profit margin ghat sakta hai. Isi liye investors sirf yeh nahi dekhte ki company ke paas achha AI model hai, balki yeh bhi dekhte hain ki woh AI ko sustainable aur profitable business mein kaise badlegi. 🔴AI companies ke case mein investors ka sawaal yeh hai ki agar company AI par ₹500 invest kare, lekin competition ki wajah se products saste mein bechne pad jaayein, to kya woh ₹900 kama payegi ya nahi. Agar is par doubt ho, to investors share bechna shuru kar dete hain.
